title: Top failing endpoints
hints: Every line has exactly four fields, so `method, path, status, _ = line.split()` unpacks one in a single step.
`Counter` accepts any iterable of keys and counts them. `most_common(n)` then gives the `n` biggest as `(key, count)` tuples, with ties in first-seen order.
`counts = Counter(f"{m} {p}" for m, p, s, _ in (line.split() for line in lines) if int(s) >= 500)` then `return counts.most_common(n)`.
